name: Emerald Tablet
governing_law: As above, so below — the law from which all transformation in this system derives.
author: Kyle Alexander Steen the Alchemist & GAIA
constraints: That which is below is like that which is above, and that which is above is like that which is below.
Separate the Earth from the Fire, the subtle from the gross, gently, with great ingenuity.
Power is integral only if it is turned toward the Earth.
affordances: May ascend from Earth to Heaven and descend again, receiving power of superiors and inferiors.
May produce admirable adaptations whose process is already stated in the tablet.
prohibitions: Must never treat the Emerald law as a syscall, an honesty flip, or a sentience claim.
Must never skip gentleness when separating the subtle from the gross.
